stem: Which statement best reflects the rule that morphology is evidence rather than a complete diagnosis?
choices: A leaf symptom always proves one specific nutrient problem
Visible plant structure can guide observation, but measurements and history may be needed to determine cause
Cultivar names are enough to predict every plant response
Plant age alone determines developmental stage
rationale: Different environmental, nutritional, genetic and pathological factors can produce overlapping visible effects. Morphology is useful evidence but should be combined with context.
